title: Sealed-version interface: prompt shape, output schema, and parameter stability contract
creator: Lena Park
description: This ticket formalizes a compatibility contract for sealed/pinned model releases. The contract defines: 1) canonical prompt shapes (structured inputs, optional metadata fields, allowed parameter keys and ranges), 2) guaranteed output schema(s) and error conditions, 3) stable parameter semantics (temperature, top_k, system instructions), and 4) migration guidance when behavior changes are necessary. The goal is to provide a machine-readable compatibility layer for customers pinning model versions and to enable automated regression checks during model onboarding and rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Publish a JSON Schema (draft-07) artifact that describes accepted prompt shapes for chat and completion endpoints
Publish canonical output schemas for structured output modes and a documented set of error response types with stable codes
Document parameter stability matrix showing which parameters are contractually stable, which are advisory, and acceptable range changes
Implement a compatibility gate in the onboarding pipeline that runs a regression suite against the pinned spec and fails onboarding on >1% semantic drift for critical prompts
Add a per-version metadata manifest (manifest.json) that clients can fetch to validate expectations
decisions: Use JSON Schema draft-07 for prompt/output validation to maximize library support across languages
Define semantic-stability as >=95% intent-preservation on canonical prompt set (open to revision with PM sign-off)
Expose a versioned manifest served from the model catalog (catalog.redwood.ai/models/{model_id}/{version}/manifest.json)
Parameter bounds: hard-contract for required parameters (e.g., max_input_tokens) and advisory ranges for quality-tuning parameters (e.g., temperature) with explicit fallback behavior
Backwards-incompatible fixes must be gated behind a major-version bump and accompanied by an automated migration guide and test diffs
rollout_plan: 1) Finalize JSON Schema and manifest format (design doc + example) 2) Implement validation library in runtimes repo and a lightweight client validator in SDKs 3) Integrate the regression harness into onboarding CI 4) Publish the contract on the model catalog and update onboarding docs 5) Monitor canary on Dedicated customers for 2 weeks then turn on enforced gating
